title: oldenlandia tetrangularis

This plant has been used in traditional medicine to exhibit various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to alleviate fever, reduce inflammation, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects and have been shown to possess anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities.
